scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres redis minio redpanda freeswitch redpanda-console keycloak && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps minio-init && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps redpanda-init
scripts.infra:bootstrap: pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:rls && pnpm db:seed && pnpm infra:identity:link
scripts.infra:ready: pnpm infra:up && pnpm infra:bootstrap && pnpm infra:check
